title: Korean Tteok Pancake with Crispy Rice
description: A crispy and crunchy Korean-inspired pancake using tteok and rice, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Grind quaint rice and crumbly tteok into a fine texture.
Mix Korean rice flour and water to create a smooth pancake batter.
Combine ground rice mixture, pancake batter, sesame oil, and a pinch of salt.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in the pancake mixture.
Cook for 4-5 minutes or until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the pancake to achieve a crispy texture.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes or until the pancake is golden brown.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
